new_candidates.body:
Hi, team stla-mines here.

Our two nuplan-warmup submissions failed with CONTESTANT_GRPC_NOT_READY (wait_for_driver_grpc): e920adec-b87b-49c7-97be-ef833c135db5 and e67ec2cf-1459-453a-93c3-4ed98e406920.

Locally the image (non-root, read-only rootfs, /tmp tmpfs) answers get_version in ~25 s with 4 replicas per GPU, on both A100 and H100.

Could you share the archived contestant driver logs (stdout/stderr of one or two replicas) for either run, as in #201 ? Also, are the per-replica container limits the same as in the sample run_local_container.sh (--memory 32g, --cpus 8, --pids-limit 1024)? Thanks!
